description: Search the lcas directory of ERC-8004 agents. Returns newest first, one entry per group of copies, with which service types passed lcas's last check. Use get_agent for full details.

chain.description: Chain ID: 1 = Ethereum, 8453 = Base. Omit for both.

domain_proved_only.description: Only agents with a working endpoint whose domain names the agent in /.well-known/agent-registration.json (ERC-8004's optional domain proof). Shows the domain's owner agrees; no signature is checked.

in_mcp_registry.description: Only agents with an MCP endpoint listed (same remote URL) in the official MCP Registry. The registry verifies the publisher's namespace, not who runs the URL.

money.description: Money hint: moves = a tool or skill says it moves funds (transfer, swap, trade, ...); pays = asks the caller for payment (x402 or HTTP 402); reads = prices, balances, tokenized assets. Word matches, not verified.

query.description: Words to match in names, descriptions, MCP tool names and A2A skill names. Omit to list all.

service.description: Only agents that declare this service type.

steady_only.description: Only steady agents: the same owner wallet for at least 90 days, and an MCP, A2A or web endpoint that lcas checked on at least 30 days and found working on at least 90% of them.

tested_only.description: Only agents whose last weekly live test passed: lcas called one read-only MCP tool or sent one A2A skill example and got an answer.

tool_findings.description: Tool-poisoning scan of tools' own text (instruction phrasing aimed at the reading app, invisible Unicode, asks for secrets or to send data out, orders about other tools). exclude = hide matches, only = show only matches. Patterns catch lazy attacks only.

working_only.description: Only agents whose MCP, A2A or web endpoint passed its last check (of `service`, if set). OASF is a description, never checked.

name: search_agents
title: Search agents
